💻 Cycle 3 complete.

**Defect** — `tests/lifecycle-tests.sh:307`, `guard: an unresolvable declared boundary fails closed`. Expected `PATH_BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVABLE`, got `PATH_PARENT_ESCAPES_BOUNDARY`.

**Root cause** — `lib/afk-common.sh:218,221` resolved boundaries with `afk_realpath`, which deliberately canonicalizes a path whose final segment doesn't exist (correct for a destination, which may legitimately be absent). So a boundary that wasn't there resolved "successfully", and every destination then failed containment against it — the guard blamed the destination for a redirection that never happened. Two facts collapsed into the wrong one.

**Fix** — `lib/afk-common.sh:213` adds `afk_resolve_boundary`: a declared boundary is territory, so it must resolve to an **existing directory**. `afk_path_guard` uses it for both the container root and the target root. Only a boundary that resolves can be escaped. Reason-code vocabulary unchanged; the `PATH_BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVABLE` message text is sharpened (nothing pins it — grepped).

One file changed, ~25 lines. `tests/lifecycle-tests.sh` and `docs/LIFECYCLE-CONTRACT.md` deliberately untouched — the assertion already encoded the correct contract and line 304 already pins the opposite case; rationale is in the story record.

**Blast radius, traced statically** — all four `afk_path_guard` call sites. `PATH_ABSENT` is tested before any boundary resolves, so pristine hosts are unaffected; six of seven components share one declared root, so an existing destination implies an existing boundary. The one cross-tree case (`model-router-claude-link` → `$AFK_SKILLS_HOME`) changes reason code only on a host shape no scenario builds, and the new answer is the more accurate one.

**Gates: I did not run them.** This session has `Read/Glob/Grep/Write` and no shell — `bash tests/lifecycle-tests.sh`, `bash tests/run-tests.sh` and `git diff --check` could not be executed. The dispatcher's independent re-run is the arbiter. Expected: 440 passed, 0 failed. What I could check statically (call sites, every direct guard assertion, no message-text dependency, no trailing whitespace, no new shellcheck finding) is recorded under **Cycle 3 gates** in `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/AFK-PORT-1.1.md`.
